import os,re,json,glob,collections
# Look for any previous submit grids in the conversation logs (JSONL messages contain escaped text).
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read()  # raw (\\n literal escapes)
s=t.replace('\\n','\n')  # actual newlines
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',s):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in s[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
